import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert text numbers to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Remove rows with negative flipper_length_mm
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0]
    
    # Remove rows with out-of-range flipper_length_mm
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    # Remove rows with out-of-range body_mass_g
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Standardize sex labels
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    cleaned_df = clean(df)
    avg_body_mass = cleaned_df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return avg_body_mass
